sentences.text: Batman is a fictional superhero appearing in American comic books published by DC Comics .	DC Comics	DC Comics	superhero	superhero	Batman	Batman (TV series)

The character was created by artist Bob Kane and writer Bill Finger , and first appeared in Detective Comics # 27 -LRB- 1939 -RRB- .	Detective Comics	Detective Comics	Bill Finger	Bill Finger	Bob Kane	Bob Kane

Originally named the `` Bat-Man '' , the character is also referred to by such epithets as the Caped Crusader , the Dark Knight , and the World 's Greatest Detective .	Dark Knight	Dark Knight (nickname)

Batman 's secret identity is Bruce Wayne , a wealthy American playboy , philanthropist , and owner of Wayne Enterprises .	secret identity	secret identity	playboy	playboy (lifestyle)	philanthropist	philanthropy	Wayne Enterprises	Wayne Enterprises	Batman	Batman (TV series)

After witnessing the murder of his parents Dr. Thomas Wayne and Martha Wayne as a child , he swore vengeance against criminals , an oath tempered by a sense of justice .	Dr. Thomas Wayne	Thomas Wayne	Martha Wayne	Martha Wayne
Bruce Wayne trains himself physically and intellectually and crafts a bat-inspired persona to fight crime .	bat-inspired	Batsuit

Batman operates in the fictional Gotham City with assistance from various supporting characters , including his butler Alfred , police commissioner Gordon , and vigilante allies such as Robin .	Robin	Robin (comics)	Gotham City	Gotham City	Alfred	Alfred Pennyworth	Gordon	James Gordon (comics)	Batman	Batman (TV series)

Unlike most superheroes , Batman does not possess any superpowers ; rather , he relies on his genius intellect , physical prowess , martial arts abilities , detective skills , science and technology , vast wealth , intimidation , and indomitable will .	superpowers	Superpower (ability)	Batman	Batman (TV series)

A large assortment of villains make up Batman 's rogues gallery , including his archenemy , the Joker .	rogues gallery	List of Batman Family adversaries	archenemy	archenemy	Joker	Joker (character)	Batman	Batman (TV series)
The character became popular soon after his introduction in 1939 and gained his own comic book title , Batman , the following year .	Batman	Batman (TV series)
As the decades went on , differing interpretations of the character emerged .
The late 1960s Batman television series used a camp aesthetic , which continued to be associated with the character for years after the show ended .	Batman	Batman (TV series)	camp	Camp (style)

Various creators worked to return the character to his dark roots , culminating in 1986 with The Dark Knight Returns by Frank Miller .	Dark Knight	Dark Knight (nickname)	The Dark Knight Returns	The Dark Knight Returns	Frank Miller	Frank Miller (comics)
The success of Warner Bros. ' live-action Batman feature films have helped maintain the public 's interest in the character .	Batman	Batman (TV series)

An American cultural icon , Batman has been licensed and adapted into a variety of media , from radio to television and film , and appears on various merchandise sold all over the world , such as toys and video games .	Batman	Batman (TV series)	variety of media	Batman franchise media
The character has also intrigued psychiatrists , with many trying to understand the character 's psyche .
In 2015 , FanSided ranked Batman as number one on their list of `` 50 Greatest Super Heroes In Comic Book History '' .	Batman	Batman (TV series)	FanSided	Time Inc.
